description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Weapons and Intimidate checks.

Bonus Action (once per scene): your next Weapons and Intimidate check before the end of your turn gains a further +1.

Technique strike (automated): use the item to roll an attack (STR modifier) and 1d4 + STR modifier physical damage. Targets Defend or Dodge as normal.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
